 Online Payment at International Student Service System
 发布者：徐卫发布时间：2025-09-01浏览次数：{动态浏览次数}
 1. Register or log in to the Soochow University International Student Service System at:
http://suda.17gz.org/
2. If no personal information is displayed, click the “Bind Study Information” button.
3. Go to “Online Payment” to check any pending fees.
4. Complete the payment using Alipay (recommended), WeChat Pay, or UnionPay.
Important Notes:
According
 to university regulations, all fees must be paid in full before the 
start of the academic year. Failure to do so will result in the 
student’s registration status remaining incomplete.
If
 the online payment system is unavailable, you may request permission 
from the Management Office to make a bank transfer. Be sure to keep the 
payment receipt for your records.
